paper_snapshot: experiments/paper_snapshot_v1.json (immutable; Phase 6 may not modify any file listed there)
research_question: Can a 3B model map previously unseen capability schemas to the canonical Skill ISA — in particular the RETRIEVAL (SEARCH/FETCH/QUERY_DB) vs ACTION (EXEC_ACTION/SEND/SAVE) boundary — independently of TaskIR program generation?

training_data: data/raw/toolbench_static/ (tool schemas, join by tool name)
inputs_allowed.note: corpus records carry capabilities as SEMANTIC SKILL STRINGS, not tool schemas (discovered in Phase 6A Task 1); real schemas are recovered by joining lowering.tool -> raw dataset tool definitions

inputs_prohibited_in_training: BFCL V4 (external-development; diagnostic only after model freeze)
tau3-bench (external-development; diagnostic only after model freeze)
AgentBoard (seen after Phase 5C confirmation; auxiliary diagnostic only)
any TaskIR plan targets, oracle future nodes, downstream plans in probe samples

sample_construction.unit: one original tool call -> one probe sample

label_tiers.G1: mapping_kind == exact (confidence 0.95, domain-identifying rule) — PRIMARY train/eval
label_tiers.G2: mapping_kind == heuristic (confidence 0.70, verb-level rule) — secondary ablation only
label_tiers.G3: mapping_kind == fallback (confidence 0.30) — AUDIT ONLY, never trained in round 1

exec_action_audit_split.exact_action_rule: mapping_kind == exact and skill == EXEC_ACTION (matched an explicit action rule, e.g. calendar/event/book/reserve regex)
exec_action_audit_split.verified_fallback: fallback label EXEC_ACTION corroborated by raw tool description matching ACTION_VERB_RE (frozen below)
exec_action_audit_split.unverified_fallback: fallback EXEC_ACTION without description corroboration — banned from all probe gold

label_tiers.toolmap_modification: FORBIDDEN — src/lifter/toolmap.py must not be changed to increase EXEC_ACTION counts

tool_family_definition.family_key: first two underscore-separated tokens of the tool name (e.g. book_flight_schedule -> book_flight)
tool_family_definition.rationale: deterministic, no hand curation; approximates service/verb-family grouping

probes.A: capability schema (name/description/parameters) -> one canonical skill label; no instruction
probes.B: task instruction + capability schema -> one canonical skill label
probes.C: task + [1 positive + 4 hard negatives from TRAIN groups] -> capability_id + skill
probes.NO_CALL: probe-only label for irrelevance; NOT a Skill ISA instruction; negatives constructed by removing the correct capability, marked synthetic_negative=true, reported separately

metrics.primary: boundary (RETRIEVAL vs ACTION) on boundary-skill samples: binary accuracy, macro F1, per-class P/R, retrieval->action and action->retrieval confusion
metrics.secondary: exact-skill multiclass (only skills with sufficient support): micro/macro F1, per-skill P/R/F1, confusion
metrics.probe_C: capability selection accuracy, skill accuracy, joint exact
metrics.counterfactual: name-masked (tool_17), description-masked, name-perturbed (api_x7) — headline credibility check
metrics.slice: action_boundary_test.jsonl: known/unseen verbs x known/unseen tool family

baselines.B2_e5cs: frozen E5C-S as classifier (no TaskIR generation)
baselines.G1_grounder: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct + QLoRA r=16 alpha=32 (same tokenizer/base as 5C), skill-grounding-only training, seeds 42/43/44, mean +/- std

output_format: single bare skill token (e.g. 'EXEC_ACTION'); no explanation, no TaskIR

external_diagnostics.order: only AFTER internal dev + OOD test complete and grounder frozen
external_diagnostics.tau3: hardened tool->skill oracle; headline: EXEC_ACTION recall vs whole-compiler ~0
external_diagnostics.agentboard: pre-registered env-visible schemas only; auxiliary failure analysis

decision_outcomes.G1_grounding_works: internal OOD boundary F1 high, EXEC_ACTION recall high, name-masked robust, external >> whole compiler -> Phase 6B two-stage frontend (Grounder -> Composer)
decision_outcomes.G2_internal_only: internal high, external low -> cross-domain capability grounding data, NOT full TaskIR synthesis
decision_outcomes.G3_grounding_fails: internal unseen-family ACTION recall low -> inspect ISA ontology/label quality/EXEC_ACTION definition before any composition work
